notes.title: Thank you all!
notes.content:
Thanks for the 10,000+ wishlists and, of course, thanks to everyone who bought the game! 
We didn't expect so much support on Steam, too; it was a real surprise!  We're already working on the next update. If you find any bugs, please report them on Discord; we're fixing everything.
